### `jwtjsonpath` matcher

JSONPath over a decoded JWT composite (PR #1210, merged 2025-12-12). Value is a NON-EMPTY JSONPath string (empty string never matches); defaults to the `$.payload` scope. https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/matching/matchers.html

**Value type:** `string`
**Config:** not supported.
**doMatch:** transforms/extracts a value for the next chained matcher (not a re-test of the same input).
